identity: Frozen original F0/E50 default6 head on actual C0 or P1 IQ; no encoder/head updates or replacement
rejection_features: Frozen uniform-OE E51 eight branches, unchanged original clean-L geometry and previous four-view augmented readout
restoration: Frozen DURA R69/v1, FP32 TF32off reuse/graph true native false

source_statistics.P1: One of three existing fixed practical/G views per physical record, iid seed2026102935 independent of y
source_statistics.calibration: One global threshold per method, existing known-V four views/30groups; F0 identity equals baseline; FRR5%/correct-rejection loss2pp; intact ties; no unknown calibration
source_statistics.sigma: Known-V score std per condition, C0 27000 and P1 81000 derived exposures, floor1e-6
source_statistics.density_eps: 95th percentile of each source sample's seventh-other-neighbor distance within same known TX/RX/day
source_statistics.new_class_radius: 95th percentile cosine distance to same-source-group leave-one-out F0-unit center
source_statistics.anchors: 90 source class/RX/day group mean unit F0 centers and mean knownness, each70 physical records; no source row bank deployed

adaptation.reliable_core: F0 and E51 MSP>=.95, argmax agree, fused prototype nearest agrees with cosine>=.5, at least2 of time/frequency/PA prototypes agree
adaptation.bias: Half class-equal mean difference between source unit prototypes and U core unit centroids, branchnorm cap.1; reference27 fixed0
adaptation.updates: One closed-form U bias state; original neural weights/readout/thresholds unchanged
adaptation.no_core: Identity bias, scientific failure recorded; no truth-driven relaxation

discovery.input: Unique U observations rejected by current primary MLP, separate DA0 and DA1
discovery.embedding: Five equal-weight whitened unit branches: fused/time/frequency/PA/PA_moments, 688 dimensions
discovery.algorithm: DBSCAN, eps source-calibrated, min_samples8, at least16 independent opaque U IDs per retained cluster
discovery.cluster_count: Inferred, zero valid; deterministic anonymous IDs from opaque-ID order
discovery.representative: Unit mean original F0 fused feature per retained cluster
discovery.penalty: Max source-anchor anonymous margin minus source-anchor old margin, clipped>=0, plus.05; U-dependent prototype fit only, no Q statistics

registration.decision: All six old and all anonymous classes compete jointly; reject if maximum margin<0, accept ties at0; deterministic old-first argmax
registration.permutation: Independent scorer uses U truth only after all future-Q predictions fixed; never Q-fit anonymous mapping or return mapping to predictor
registration.new_accuracy_denominator: All true novel arrivals in U, including undiscovered/unmatched devices; unmatched anonymous predictions are errors, not rejection

evaluation.diagnostic_rejection_methods: Seven scores for REG0; anonymous registration uses preregistered MLP only
evaluation.truth_last: Four states per condition complete before separate U/Q scorer
evaluation.evidence_scope: Single-seed RX24-1 development, exposed source novel devices and dates; not independent formal confirmation

stop: Technical source/role/identity/collision/nonfinite/incomplete prediction failure preserves partial; zero discovered clusters or failed scientific goals do not retune or retry
